market_name: Will 11 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether Treasury yields (2y/10y) and TLT are actually moving lower; cross-check against any macro headlines or Fed-speak.
time_plan.1h: Confirm move is not a one-off print; watch fed funds futures (implied 2026 cuts) for corroboration.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether risk assets (SPY) and rates are moving consistently with a dovish/recession narrative.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether the prediction-market shift persisted or reverted; check for scheduled data (CPI, jobs) or Fed communications.
time_plan.12h: Tally TLT move vs. 40bps expectation; log whether any public catalyst emerged that explains the market shift.

predictions.reasoning: An extreme strike of 11 rate cuts (275bps) in 2026 only becomes plausible in a hard-landing/emergency-easing scenario. If this market's implied probability spiked, it would signal rising expectations of aggressive Fed easing, which pushes front- and long-end yields lower and bond prices higher. TLT is the most liquid duration proxy. But an 11-cut path is a deep tail; any probability move is more likely noise than genuine leakage, and 12h public-market reaction would be small.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY/UUP direction and whether it aligns with lower yields.
time_plan.1h: Look for confirmation across EURUSD/USDJPY that the move is rate-driven, not risk-off.
time_plan.2h: Distinguish dovish-easing (dollar down) from crisis safe-haven (dollar up) interpretation.
time_plan.6h: Reassess persistence and any macro catalyst; watch for Fed commentary.
time_plan.12h: Compare UUP realized move to -25bps expectation and note whether safe-haven flows overrode the rate-differential channel.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the probability of many 2026 Fed cuts implies a lower expected US rate path, which typically weakens the dollar via narrowing rate differentials. UUP is a liquid dollar proxy. However, in a genuine crisis-driven easing scenario the dollar can strengthen on safe-haven flows, making direction genuinely ambiguous; hence low confidence.

evidence_used: Market strike: 11 cuts (~275bps) in 2026, an extreme dovish tail requiring recession/emergency easing
Fed easing expectations map directly to Treasury yields, the dollar, and gold
Liquid proxies: TLT for duration, UUP for the dollar
12h window and 700bps tradability threshold are very demanding for these liquid ETFs
uncertainty_notes: Neither prediction is expected to reach the 700bps tradable threshold — these are research signals only
An 11-cut strike is a deep tail; probability moves there are frequently noise/low-liquidity artifacts
Crisis-driven easing could flip the dollar direction to up (safe haven) and pressure equities, muddying the mapping
Prediction-market resolution runs through Dec 2026, so a probability shift may reflect long-horizon repricing, not an imminent 12h catalyst

llm_justification.summary: The market asks whether the Fed delivers 11 (25bps) cuts in 2026 — an extreme dovish/recession tail. If its implied probability spiked, the cleanest public-market read is expectations of aggressive easing: lower Treasury yields (TLT up) and a softer dollar (UUP down). Both mappings are weak over a 12h window: the strike is a deep tail prone to noise, crisis scenarios can reverse the dollar via safe-haven flows, and realized moves are very unlikely to clear the 700bps tradable bar. Treated as low-confidence research signals only.
key_assumptions: A rising probability of many cuts reflects genuine dovish/recession repricing, not thin-market noise
Rate-differential channel dominates dollar direction rather than safe-haven flows
TLT and UUP remain representative, liquid proxies for duration and the dollar
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is a low-liquidity artifact with no real information content
The information was already public (e.g., a data release) and is fully priced in
Crisis-driven easing triggers a stronger dollar (safe haven), reversing the UUP call
Long resolution horizon means no 12h public-market reaction materializes
Proxies move for unrelated macro reasons, breaking the causal link
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
